### Work Breakdown Structure
- Site Preparation
  - Mobilization and site setup (2 crew days)
  - Temporary fencing and signage (1 crew day)
  - Minor grading and leveling (2 crew days)
- Foundations
  - Excavation for foundations (2 crew days)
  - Formwork and reinforcement (3 crew days)
  - Concrete pour and curing (3 crew days)
- Structural Shell
  - External and internal load-bearing walls (5 crew days)
  - Roof framing and installation (4 crew days)
  - Roof waterproofing and insulation (2 crew days)
- Building Envelope
  - Exterior wall finishes (brick, stucco, etc.) (3 crew days)
  - Window and door installation (2 crew days)
- Interior Construction
  - Partition walls and drywall (3 crew days)
  - Flooring installation (3 crew days)
  - Ceiling installation (2 crew days)
- MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing)
  - Rough-in plumbing (2 crew days)
  - Rough-in electrical (2 crew days)
  - HVAC installation (3 crew days)
  - Final plumbing and electrical fixtures (2 crew days)
- Finishes
  - Painting and wall finishes (3 crew days)
  - Millwork and shelving installation (2 crew days)
  - Bathroom fixtures and accessories (1 crew day)
- Site Works and Landscaping
  - Sidewalks and paving (2 crew days)
  - Landscaping and planting (2 crew days)
- Finalization
  - Cleaning and punch list (2 crew days)
  - Client walkthrough and handover (1 crew day)

### Total Estimate
55 crew days

### Assumptions
- Crew size is 6-8 workers per day, with specialized subcontractors for MEP and finishes.
- All materials are readily available and delivered on schedule.
- No major weather delays or site access issues.
- Design drawings are fully approved and require no changes.
- The site is already cleared and utilities are available at the lot boundary.
- Library is a standard single-storey structure with no unusual features or high-end finishes.
- Effort estimates do not include permitting or off-site fabrication.
